# Groups triggers

## Group added

Runs when a new, empty group of viewers is created. Groups are lists of viewers, like "Trusted", made on the Users & Groups page or with an action.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Group** | The group's name. Empty means any group. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%groupName%` | The name of the group |

<small>Type id: `groups.added`</small>

## Group cleared

Runs when every viewer is taken out of a group at once, but the group itself stays.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Group** | The group's name. Empty means any group. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%groupName%` | The name of the group |
| `%count%` | How many viewers were taken out |

<small>Type id: `groups.cleared`</small>

## Group removed

Runs when a group of viewers is deleted.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Group** | The group's name. Empty means any group. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%groupName%` | The name of the group |

<small>Type id: `groups.removed`</small>

## Users added to group

Runs when a viewer is put into a group. Good for welcoming someone to "VIPs" or "Trusted".

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Group** | The group's name. Empty means any group. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%groupName%` | The name of the group |
| `%user%` | The viewer who was added |
| `%userId%` | The viewer's id on their platform |
| `%platform%` | The site the viewer is on, like twitch |

<small>Type id: `groups.usersAdded`</small>

## Users removed from group

Runs when a viewer is taken out of a group.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Group** | The group's name. Empty means any group. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%groupName%` | The name of the group |
| `%user%` | The viewer who was removed |
| `%userId%` | The viewer's id on their platform |
| `%platform%` | The site the viewer is on, like twitch |

<small>Type id: `groups.usersRemoved`</small>
